# Timely — Tasks & Research Notes

## Source & Preview

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar V09 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-09/`)
- **Live Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/calendar-09/`
- **Original Name**: Calendar 09
- **New Assigned Name**: `timely`

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Plan

1. **Navbar / Header**: Minimalist branding, title, quick navigation links.
2. **Main Calendar Widget**: Interactive calendar picker card featuring month view, day grid, selection states, and time selection input (`MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss`).
3. **Event Schedule Panel**: List of scheduled events for the active date with quick add/remove capability.
4. **Footer**: Clean attribution linking `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").
